research.title: Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation & Calibration for a Real Signalized Junction
highlights: Converted CVAT video annotations into per-vehicle trajectories with turning-movement reconstruction for a real 8-arm junction.

Simulated all 8 roads under a real 4-phase signal cycle using a hybrid Social Force + IDM multi-agent model with collision resolution. Automated parameter calibration via annealed random search across 8 road datasets.
